title: Passage from functorial complex resolutions to homotopy derivability
statement: Let $A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Use cochain complexes, quasi-isomorphisms, shifts and mapping cones of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $K(A)$ have complexes as objects and cochain maps modulo homotopy $f-g=d h+h d$ as morphisms, and let $q:\mathrm{CoCh}(A)\to K(A)$ be the quotient. Let $\mathcal P$ be a property of objects of $K(A)$ closed under isomorphisms, containing zero and stable under all integer shifts and mapping cones. Equivalently its full subcategory is triangulated: in any triangle isomorphic to a mapping-cone triangle, membership of two vertices implies membership of the third. Suppose there are a functor $\rho:\mathrm{CoCh}(A)\to\mathrm{CoCh}(A)$ and a natural transformation $p:\rho\Rightarrow\operatorname{id}$ such that every $p_L$ is a quasi-isomorphism and $\mathcal P(q\rho L)$ holds for every complex $L$. Then the full inclusion $K(A)_{\mathcal P}\to K(A)$, equipped on both sides with quasi-isomorphisms, is a left derivability structure [def-sfb-left-derivability-structure]. Only functoriality on complexes is assumed; no functor on $K(A)$ induced by $\rho$ is required.

lean.statement:
lemma isLeftDerivabilityStructure_quasiIsoLocalizerMorphism
    {ρ : CochainComplex A ℤ ⥤ CochainComplex A ℤ} (p : ρ ⟶ 𝟭 _)
    (hp : ∀ K, QuasiIso (p.app K)) (hρ : ∀ K, P ((quotient A (.up ℤ)).obj (ρ.obj K))) :
    (quasiIsoLocalizerMorphism P).IsLeftDerivabilityStructure
lean.note: Exact existing upstream criterion, including the ambient abelian-category binders and [P.IsTriangulated] [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms] from the surrounding section. The functor rho is defined on cochain complexes only. quasiIsoLocalizerMorphism P is the full inclusion with quasi-isomorphisms and their inverse image. No new declaration is introduced.

reviewed_lean.note: The existing:true record names HomotopyCategory.isLeftDerivabilityStructure_quasiIsoLocalizerMorphism (DerivabilityStructure.lean:211-214, identical in slopmaster2 and clones/side). lean.statement is verbatim and the theorem is fully proved (axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only). All clauses match: Abelian A with free universes; P with IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms and IsTriangulated, which is equivalent to the node's zero/shift/cone conditions (Subcategory.lean:193-204); rho a functor on CochainComplex only; p : rho to identity with QuasiIso components; P(q rho K); the conclusion is IsLeftDerivabilityStructure of P.iota with quasiIso and its inverse image. No extra hypotheses; edge cases fine; the consumer lem-sfb-kflat-derivability uses this interface.
